summary.text: Stephanie Sawyer-Clayton is a Democratic state representative who has represented District 19 since January 2013 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists her as Stephanie Clayton.
She switched her party affiliation from Republican to Democratic in December 2018.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Clayton earned a B.A. in history from Emporia State University, according to Ballotpedia.
She assumed office in the Kansas House on January 14, 2013.

On December 19, 2018, she announced that she was switching her party affiliation from Republican to Democratic, saying she believed she could better serve her constituents and support education as a member of the Democratic Party.

For 2025 and 2026 Ballotpedia lists her committee assignments as House Federal and State Affairs, Rules and Journal (vice chair), Taxation, Commerce, Labor and Economic Development (ranking minority member), and State-Tribal Relations.
